validationSteps.run:
socket="/run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock"
command -v podman
if [ ! -S "$socket" ]; then
systemctl --user start podman.socket
fi
test -S "$socket"
podman --version

validationSteps.name: Detect security-sensitive path changes
validationSteps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "push" ] && [ "${{ github.ref }}" = "refs/heads/main" ]; then
echo "security_sensitive=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "security_sensitive=true (exact-main always runs HTTP surfaces)"
exit 0
fi
node scripts/ci-security-sensitive-paths.mjs

validationSteps.name: Ensure rootless Podman socket

command -v podman

podman --version

validationSteps.name: Enforce SECURITY_SENSITIVE_PR_CANNOT_MERGE_WITH_RELEVANT_HTTP_INTEGRATION_SUITE_SKIPPED
validationSteps.run:
set -euo pipefail
echo "security_sensitive=${SENSITIVE}"
echo "http_surfaces_result=${HTTP_RESULT}"
if [ "${SENSITIVE}" = "true" ]; then
if [ "${HTTP_RESULT}" != "success" ]; then
echo "::error::Security-sensitive PR requires http-surfaces success (got ${HTTP_RESULT})."
exit 1
fi
fi
echo "Security HTTP gate passed."
